title: An enabled member can act as any other member on user routes
description:
assertIntegrationTestUserId (conversation/src/auth/integration-test.ts:382-389) returns immediately unless the principal kind is integration, so for a real Cognito user the body's author_id is trusted (http/routes/messages.ts:93-105). Any enabled member can post as another participant or as a bot, create channels and tasks for another user_id, and list another user's channels and tasks (routes/channels.ts:78,96; routes/tasks.ts:93,107,142).

Fix: rename the helper to assertActingUserId and enforce actorUserId === principal.userId for every principal kind; refuse author_kind bot on the user message route (bots post through the executor); require the principal to be a participant before listing or posting to a channel; bind /users/{user_id} routes to the principal or to owners. One Gherkin refusal scenario per route, failing before the fix.
